prompts.combat:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production cartoon game combat sprite atlas of the forest creature in the user's reference. Preserve mint turquoise quadruped body with dark teal diamond markings, pointed ears, green eyes, white fangs and toe claws, large jagged leaves and rounded green shrub on back. EXACTLY four legs, NO tail. FOUR thorny green vines rooted in its back foliage, each terminating in one leaf tip; keep them compact, clearly connected to back, consistent count, no detached vines. Clean cel-shaded cartoon outlines matching reference.
EXACTLY SIX columns by FIVE rows of equal cells. Six progressive poses in each row, all facing RIGHT three-quarter side view. Same body size and camera throughout, feet near 88% cell height. Large transparent margins; all vines, leaves and feet contained inside their own cells. No text, labels, grid, ground shadows or background. Actual alpha transparent PNG.
Row1 vine strike: ready pose, brace legs, pull front vine back, ONE front vine sweeps forward in short arc, retract vine, neutral recovery. The other three vines remain curled close to shrub. Do not draw duplicated motion trails.
Row2 cast: neutral, lower head slightly gathering energy at foliage, leaves rise a little, mouth open emitting a tiny green seed spark, follow-through, neutral. No fire.
Row3 dash: compress body, hind-leg push-off, low forward stretch, opposite quadruped stride, brake front paws, settle neutral.
Row4 backstep: neutral, shift weight, front feet lift, short backward hop, rear feet land, return neutral. Still faces right.
Row5 crouch seamless loop: body low on four bent legs, subtle breathing, compact leaves/vines, small leaf sway, blink, near starting low stance.
Prioritize clear consistent anatomy, stable creature proportions, gradual adjacent poses with limb overlap and organic vine follow-through.
prompts.run: Create a six-frame running animation sheet of the friendly turquoise forest creature in this reference. Match its exact cartoon appearance, teal body markings, pointed ears, white claws, leafy back shrub and short curled vines. Four legs, no tail. Three columns by two rows, six equal separate panels, reading order. All face right, same camera, same head and body size. Frame 1 right-front/left-rear feet contact, frame 2 weight compresses, frame 3 legs pass under body, frame 4 left-front/right-rear contact, frame 5 compress, frame 6 passing back to frame 1. Keep the body level, a gentle four-legged trot, foliage sways subtly after each step. Whole creature fits inside every cell with generous transparent padding. True transparent background. No text, grid lines or scenery.
prompts.jump: A six-frame cartoon jump animation sheet of the exact friendly turquoise leafy creature in the reference. Preserve its face, green eyes, pointed ears, dark teal body markings, white claws, leafy shrub and short curled vines. Exactly four legs, no tail. Three columns by two rows of equal cells, six complete separate creatures in reading order, all facing RIGHT, same scale and camera. Pose 1 crouched low, pose 2 hind legs push off and front feet rise, pose 3 all feet off ground and legs start bending, pose 4 knees tuck closer, pose 5 tucked legs at apex, pose 6 legs begin to relax down. prompts.reactions:
